name: Independence
intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Independence for 2026, and here is what he found: 12 family events, at least 3 of them free. The magic runs from November 28 (Englewood Parade of Lights) through December 19 (Holiday on Strings at the Puppetry Arts Institute), with the Winter Solstice Torchlit Hike (December 2), the Mayor's Tree Lighting and Living Windows on the Square (December 4) and Cookies and Cocoa with Mrs. Claus (December 12) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Independence

  • 12 Christmas events for kids in Independence, counting 2 already live, 2 moving from the Kansas City page and 8 new ones
  • At least 3 free events, including the Englewood Parade of Lights, the Winter Solstice Torchlit Hike and the Mayor's Christmas Concert
  • Meet Santa: Cookies and Cocoa with Mrs. Claus, Santa storytimes at two Mid-Continent library branches and Santa Skate at Cable Dahmer Arena
  • Parades and tree lightings: Englewood Parade of Lights (November 28), the Mayor's Tree Lighting (December 4) and Living Windows on the Square (December 4)
  • Shows: Holiday on Strings, The Littlest Angel (December 5, 12 and 19)
  • Season: November 28, 2026 to December 19, 2026 for the new listings

Planning a bigger day out? Independence families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Kansas City, which covers Destination North Pole at Crown Center, Holiday Reflections at Union Station, the Plaza lighting ceremony and Santa visits at Zona Rosa.
